name: MCP Policy Gatekeeper
description: Provides real-time policy enforcement for AI coding agents by intercepting and validating their actions against organizational standards like naming conventions, security policies, and compliance rules before execution. Prevents violations through immediate feedback and auto-correction suggestions.
